_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Statistically a coil (flat momentum, no clean breaker); HOLD at Denial is the graded call until flows or fear_greed force a ±1 rung step.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — both treat tape as measured/Denial now; analyst wants HOLD but labels next Disbelief (rejected by ±1 rule); narrative has no forward phase
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC rangebound, 30d momentum near zero, fear_greed inside 47-62
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows leave single digits on a price break, or long/skew unwind drives fear_greed through 46 or above 63
